feed.subtitle: Shresth Grover is an AI researcher and Visiting Researcher at Princeton University's PRISM Lab (MS CS, UC San Diego; B.Tech, IIT Kanpur), working on multimodal foundation models, vision-language-action (VLA) models, robot learning and temporal reasoning, with publications at NeurIPS, ECCV, IROS, ACL and EMNLP.
